title: Preserve MLP momentum history when continuing training
body:
### Description

Continuing a `MultiLayerPerceptron` fit with nonzero momentum raises `UnboundLocalError`: the previous-gradient arrays are local variables initialized only when `init_params=True`.

Store those four history arrays on the fitted model. Each update retains the history for the next fit or a serialized-model round trip; reinitializing the parameters resets it. The existing momentum update equation is unchanged.

### Validation

Base: `1aee767ef57b84a8191511a08955c583b65de382`.

- Seven new regression/control cases: **4 failed, 3 passed** on unchanged master; **7 passed** with the fix.
- For two nonzero momentum values, continued fitting and a real pickle round trip match uninterrupted training in all weights, biases and epoch costs. Zero-momentum and parameter-reinitialization cases are controls.
- `PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m pytest mlxtend/classifier/tests/test_mlp_momentum_continuation.py mlxtend/classifier/tests/test_multilayerperceptron.py -q`: **21 passed**.
- Changed-file Black, isort, Flake8 and `git diff --check` passed.

Python 3.12.14, NumPy 2.3.5. Validation covers a fixed momentum configuration and checkpoints produced by the corrected model. Enabling momentum after a zero-momentum fit and migrating older pickles without this history are outside this change's validation. The full repository suite was not run.

### Pull Request Checklist

- [x] Added a changelog entry.
- [x] Added continuation, serialization and reset regression/control tests.
- [x] Documented momentum-history retention.
- [x] Relevant tests and changed-file style checks pass.

validation.evidence_source: Published upstream PR body preserved here; earlier local execution logs are not reconstructed after workspace reset.
